title: Can Book of Moon be activated during the Damage Step?

messages.text: Can Book of Moon be activated during the Damage Step?

parts.text: Can Book of Moon be activated during the Damage Step?

messages.text: These rulings don't settle it. **Book of Moon**'s own rulings only cover the Battle Step: used on a defending monster the attack still resolves, and used on an attacking monster the attack stops before the Damage Step. The Damage Step rulings only bar Quick-Play Spells from *negating* there.

title: Does Sangan trigger if it is banished from the field?

messages.text: Does Sangan trigger if it is banished from the field?

parts.text: Does Sangan trigger if it is banished from the field?

messages.text: No. **Sangan** only triggers when it is sent from the field to the Graveyard, and a banished Sangan never gets there. The **Nobleman of Crossout** and **Banisher of the Light** rulings both say its effect will not activate.

title: Can Sinister Serpent be targeted in the graveyard during the Standby Phase?

messages.text: Can Sinister Serpent be targeted in the graveyard during the Standby Phase?

parts.text: Can Sinister Serpent be targeted in the graveyard during the Standby Phase?

messages.text: Yes. Nothing in the rulings protects it in the Graveyard, and effects like **Disappear** target Graveyard cards. Its own Standby Phase effect does not target it, though, so **Big Burn** cannot be activated in response.
